Experience: 13 Years  
Job Type: Full-Time (In office)  
Location: Coimbatore  
Salary: 20,000  25,000 per month

About the Role

We are looking for a talented and creative 2D Motion Graphics Artist to join our game development team. You will be responsible for creating engaging motion graphics and UI animations for our medieval Real-Time Strategy (RTS) game. Your work will play a key role in enhancing the game's visual appeal and overall user experience.

Key Responsibilities

- Create high-quality 2D motion graphics for game UI and user interactions.
- Design and animate menus, HUD elements, buttons, icons, tooltips, and loading screens.
- Develop animations for game events such as victory, defeat, level-up, notifications, tutorials, and other in-game interfaces.
- Create videos, gameplay trailers, cut scenes.
- Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, game artists, and developers to deliver polished animations.

Requirements

- 13 years of experience as a Motion Graphics Artist or in a similar role.
- Proficiency in Adobe After Effects.
- Good working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Ph

Hevo moves data for more than 2,000 companies, including IcelandAir, Shopify, Postman, ThoughtSpot. Your job is to make all of that feel obvious.
